beforeShellExecution.command:
/bin/sh -c 'PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin"; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agentprint: uvx not found, so this command was not checked (install uv to turn it on)" >&2; printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'{"permission": "allow"}'"'"'; exit 0; }; out=$(uvx --from agentprint==0.1.1 agentprint guard --agent cursor); s=$?; case "$s" in 0) [ -n "$out" ] && printf "%s
" "$out"; exit 0 ;; 3) [ -n "$out" ] && printf "%s
" "$out"; exit 2 ;; esac; echo "agentprint: hook check failed (exit $s); the command was allowed" >&2; printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'{"permission": "allow"}'"'"'; exit 0' agentprint-plugin
